metadata.purpose: Reusable internal scoring configuration; not private market research or vendor scoring claims.

SEMANTIC_QUALIFICATION_GRADING.description: Parsed candidate profile compared against job qualifications, often with semantic or AI evaluation; exact employer module/configuration may be optional.
resume_strategy: prove every required qualification in context
use exact JD form once for critical terms
use semantic depth rather than repetition

CALIBRATED_SEMANTIC_MATCH.description: Hiring team defines calibration criteria and importance; matching uses parsed resume concepts and related terms.
resume_strategy: show relevant job titles and experience context
do not keyword-repeat because related terms can map to one skill

CONFIGURABLE_AI_RATING.description: AI rating or matching may score structured dimensions such as education, experience, and skills with administrator-defined weights.
resume_strategy: show skill use inside relevant experience
align years/title context without inflating tenure
treat employer weighting as unknown unless configured values are known

SKILLS_ONTOLOGY_MATCH.description: Skills are extracted from job descriptions and resumes and matched through a skills ontology or AI-assisted compatibility layer.
resume_strategy: cover primary and secondary role skills
place high-value skills in proof-bearing context
retain canonical skill names and exact vendor names
include adjacent technical skills only when role-relevant
avoid bloated skill lists that lack proof

PARSE_MATCH_RANK.description: Resume parsing plus candidate search, recommendation, or matching/ranking; public exact weights are usually not disclosed.

FULL_TEXT_STRUCTURED_SEARCH.description: ATS emphasizes parsed candidate records, exact/full-text/Boolean search, filters, and recruiter review; semantic AI may be optional or secondary.
resume_strategy: use common abbreviations plus JD form when useful
put niche terms in Technical Skills if proof context is awkward

LEGACY_ENTERPRISE_MATCH.description: Older enterprise ATS with candidate profiles, requisition criteria, keyword/search filtering, and configurable screening; semantic matching is less consistently documented.
resume_strategy: avoid depending on semantic synonym recognition

INSTITUTIONAL_HUMAN_WORKFLOW.description: University, healthcare, government, or institutional recruiting workflow where structured applications, screening questions, recruiter/search-committee review, and attachments are important.
resume_strategy: optimize for both recruiter and committee readability
do not trade human readability for minor keyword gains

HCM_WORKFLOW_SEARCH.description: General HCM recruiting workflow with structured applicant records, configurable filters/questions, parsing/search, and primarily human decision-making.
resume_strategy: do not assume native AI ranking is enabled

SMB_ATS_SEARCH.description: SMB or mid-market ATS centered on parsing, candidate organization, filters/search, workflow, and recruiter review; advanced scoring varies by product tier and integrations.

STAFFING_CRM_SEARCH.description: Agency/staffing ATS and CRM where resumes are parsed, indexed, repeatedly searched, and reused across requisitions.
resume_strategy: include exact niche tools and domains
make recent use and role context clear
use technically dense but recruiter-readable bullets

FEDERAL_ASSESSMENT.description: Federal hiring ecosystem where minimum qualifications, screen-outs, assessment questionnaires, selective/quality ranking factors, structured resume review, and other assessments may determine eligibility and ranking.
resume_strategy: treat specialized experience language as critical
answer questionnaires consistently with resume evidence
do not use private-sector one-page compression blindly

HIGH_VOLUME_STRUCTURED.description: High-volume or conversational hiring where screening questions, eligibility, availability, assessments, and workflow steps often matter more than deep resume matching.
resume_strategy: ensure structured application answers are consistent

EXPERIENCE_LAYER_OR_CRM.description: Recruitment experience, CRM, or AI layer that may sit on top of another ATS. The underlying ATS must be resolved separately whenever possible.
resume_strategy: optimize both semantic matching and recruiter search

UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVE_MIXED.description: Conservative mixed ATS profile used only when the actual ATS cannot be resolved. Protects hard qualifications, structured resume data, exact searchable terminology, semantic coverage, and parseability without pretending the employer's private ranking logic is known.
UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVE_MIXED.keyword_frequency_policy: Near-zero incremental value beyond natural contextual repetition.
resume_strategy: do not infer proprietary scoring behavior
